answer: Each identity anchors to one PDO-certified artisan cheese dairy: the certifier inspects the dairy, tests milk origin, issues one certificate naming one identity; a second claim on the same dairy is rejected. Entry costs one real dairy, 1,600 units in fees, plus a 180-day voyage from curd to saleable wheel. 100 fakes cost 160,000 units, 100 dairies and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: renting a dairy for 1,000 units a season, but the lender surrenders the certificate backing its own identity, and a hollow wheel with no milk trail fails the delta test matching each batch to its named pasture.
